intro.text: Galladon's father, a farmer from Duladel who moved his wife and son to Elantris after the Shaod took him.

items.text: He was never content in Elantris and wanted only to be a simple farmer again. Unable to forget his homeland, he became a scholar of agriculture, though such study was of no use in the city. Elantrians were unwelcome in other lands, so he could never go back to Duladel.

One morning he woke to find his wife dying beside him of an illness that had struck without warning, and his Elantrian powers could not heal her. Already unhappy, he sank into deep depression, and his suffering convinced Galladon that Elantrians were not truly gods.

He urged Galladon to return to Duladel and farm once he was old enough to live alone. Soon afterwards he fell ill with heart-death, but instead of seeking healers he shut himself away in his small underground study. His Elantrian body kept him alive for a time, and he died about a year after Galladon left.

Raised in the city, Galladon knew its routes and hiding places well. After the Shaod took him too, he found his father's old study, cleaned the slime from it and guarded it and its books closely. Raoden was the first person he showed it to, and together they found answers about the Aons in his father's books.

appearance.text: Like other Elantrians of his day, his skin was silver and gave off a faint glow.

personality.text: He loved his homeland and his family, yet becoming an Elantrian left him bitter, and he fell into a severe depression.
